window.Webflow.push(function () {
  var $ = window.jQuery;

  $(document).on('click', '.js-close-dropdown', function () {
    var $dd = $(this).closest('.w-dropdown');
    if (!$dd.length) return;
    $dd.trigger('w-close');
    $dd.children('.w-dropdown-toggle').blur();
  });
});
</script>
